# Vendored Pontryagin modules

The files under `Pontryagin/` are the minimal transitive module closure of
`Pontryagin.EvalInjective` from:

- Repository: https://github.com/shosonoda/pontryagin
- Revision: `4f72437124104369dc18ac380061bc2006f8e392`
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

The upstream files target Lean/Mathlib v4.32.0. Local compatibility changes for
the FLT Lean v4.34.0-rc1 toolchain are documented by the Git history.
